name: Cheat Engine（KSword R0）
description: Runs the bundled Cheat Engine as a process action or embedded KSword Tab, with memory interaction routed through the KSword driver.

commands.name: launch
commands.description: Verify KSword R0, initialize the CE bridge and open the selected process.

commands.name: tab
commands.description: Create a verified native child window and embed Cheat Engine in the KSword Plugins Tab.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Check whether the KSword R0 device is available without showing UI.

commands.name: info
commands.description: Print plugin capabilities as JSON Lines.
